administrative examples without systematically mapping every required lens."],"concrete_corrections_required":["Add the most material omitted candidate-index evidence to 4B.7, especially police contemporaneous validation of the electoral framework to 4B.8, while retaining the explicit gap on actual transfer and coalition succession commitments.","Add the candidate-index evidence on online hate-speech enforcement and chat-control debates to 4B.9, with careful separation from surveillance procurement.","Add formal democratic-resilience and accountability evidence to 4B.10, including whistleblower protection, party-finance safeguards, and independent oversight, while preserving the non-attribution caveat."],"safe_for_judge_use":true,"rationale":"All four answers are materially reliable and useful to a skeptical judge. The cited claims are well supported, period handling is strong, and attribution is appropriately constrained. The principal defect is incomplete coverage of the full candidate index rather than factual error. Targeted additions are required for a fully comprehensive chapter-level judgment."}
